content:
Don't get lost in the maze of performance! You do not have to perform, you are already well pleasing to the Father. See yourself as liveas one who is well pleasing to God! You don't live to please God,  but you live and show forth the Life of one who is well pleasing unto God! Before Jesus ever performed a miracle or preached a sermon the Father said this is my beloved Son in whom I am well pleased! You are the delight of the Father, not because of what you done, but because it's who you are! 
_2Pe 1:17 For He received from God the Father honour and glory, when there came such a voice to him from the excellent glory, This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased._
*#GraceGalore*

You are called to live beyond the elements of this World! How much are you willing to experience a supernatural life! Your life in Christ was designed to be lived above the standards of the World! The Lord calls us out of the World to walk in the Light of His Glory, it's not only in terms of the can of lifestyle we live but it is us also in terms of our experiences in life. With Jesus as the Lord of your life, you cannot buy have a supernatural life! 
_Rom 8:2 For the law of the Spirit of life in Christ Jesus hath made me free from the law of sin and death._
*#GraceGalore*

Come Let us adore Him Christ the Lord! Jesus is not just Lord, He is THE LORD! Christmas season is a great reminder of this fact, every people, of every race,  no matter the religious beliefs, celebrate and regard Christmas as time of festivity! The coming of Christ to Earth is the biggest celebration on Calendar! Jesus is the King of Kings, boldly declare His praise to all creation! Blessed Christmas! 
_1Ti 6:15 Which in His times He shall shew, who is the blessed and only Potentate, the King of kings, and Lord of lords_
*#GraceGalore*

Before the angels sung Hosanna in the highest, before the shepherds came to worship the new born king, before the Star led the Wise men to the Holy Child, Mary received the Word and believed it in private. You don't need a crowd to believe with you, they will all rejoice at your manifestation of what the Lord spoke to you when no one was watching! Before you can experience anything that Heaven and Earth will see and celebrate you have to believe the Word of God in Private. Blessed are you who has believed!
_Luk 1:45 And blessed is she that believed: for there shall be a performance of those things which were told her from the Lord._
*#GraceGalore*

We are not waiting another 365 days for us to remember and celebrate the birth of our Savior Jesus Christ, everyday is a celebration of the Incarnation. When we now look at our Lives we see Divinity wrapped in Human just as Jesus was. We are not mere human beings, we have the God nature within us, our being here on Earth is Joy to the world, we are the ones to Shine His Light to all! 
_Joh 20:21 Then said Jesus to them again, Peace be unto you: as my Father hath sent me, even so send I you._
*#GraceGalore*

Jesus came that we may have Life to the full, there is a quality of life that the Lord has made available to you, it is what every believer has by default, you have received an inheritance in Him. Most feel like they need to attend this life by doing certain things, but the truth is you were born into this life, what did Prince Charles of England do to live the quality of life he has today? All he did was to be born in the Royal Family! You were born into the Monarchy of the Universe! Yours now is to be trained to live this life that is already yours! 
_Gal 4:1 Now I say, That the heir, as long as he is a child, differeth nothing from a servant, though he be lord of all_
*#GraceGalore*

The New Year is truly a season loaded with greatness, there is so much that the Lord desires to manifest in your life, yet many have the mindset that 2018 will deliver to them all the blessed things that have been spoken about it just because it is 2018, and at the end of the year they find themselves saying, 2019 will be my year, and at the end of that year they'll say the next year will be my year! This is because many fail to capture the moment! To live and position yourself to receive all that God has for you right now! Stop postponing your blessing to next year. Faith is a present tense reality, Jesus doesn't not dwell in time, You can experience anything that Heaven has for you right now! 
_Heb 13:8 Jesus Christ the same Yesterday, Today and Forever._
*#GraceGalore*

You cannot lose what you are, you may not use it but you cannot lose it! The New Testament is not based on God giving us something, but rather it is about Him making us something! Ours is now to know exactly WHO God has made us out to be and then fulfil all that He desires us to do. What you do is not what determines who you are, but rather it is who you are that determines what you do. The question then is who are you? You are righteousness of God in Christ, you are the light of the World, you are the salt of the Earth, you are a Royal Priesthood and Chosen Generation! 
_Eph 2:10 We are His workmanship created in Christ Jesus for good works which God prepared before hand that we should walk in them._
*#GraceGalore*

The Whole Cosmos revolves around this person called Jesus! No matter what you do, He is undeniably the reason why we are here! See Jesus in and above all things this day focus on Him desire Him and His fullness. He is the Alpha and Omega, your Strength, Wisdom and Power to begin and end a Year! Let your New Years Resolution be Jesus Christ and His Fullness, He has never failed and never will!
_John 10:10 The thief comes not but for to steal kill and destroy but I am come that they may have life and that they may have it to the full_
*#GraceGalore*

Perfect New Year! Wow,  it's a brand new Year with brand new things! But only for those who will decide it to be so! May all of the dreams in your heart become true may you live and experience the Fullness of that the Lord has spoken to you this year! Refuse to be passive, TAKE this year by storm, make it Happen do not settle for less, surpass all expectations, fulfill Greatness! 
_Rom 5:17 They which Receive (Lay hold of) abundance of Grace and the gift of righteousness will reign in life by one Christ Jesus_
*#GraceGalore*

There is a commodity that is so abundant in Heaven that it is the hallmark of defining the unlimited presence of God... JOY! Joy is such a powerful virtue that most people don't realize how costly it is to live without! There is a notion that our experience with God is marked by a somber shrinking feeling! But on the contrary Jesus gives us Joy, and it is this atmosphere that completely strips the devil of his ability to bind you! Joy is your life, let it pour out from deep within you! 
_Psa 16:11 Thou wilt shew me the path of life: in thy presence is fullness of joy; at thy right hand there are pleasures for evermore._
*#GraceGalore*

It doesn't matter how far or how long you've been walking down the wrong road, you can turn around today, when the Light of God's truth dawn's in your heart, you can make the change, no one is too far gone! Come boldly before the throne of Grace, you have not missed your destiny! The Grace of God is way more Powerful than your mistake! Receive it Today! 
_Heb 4:16 Let us therefore come boldly unto the throne of grace, that we may obtain mercy, and find grace to help in time of need._
*#GraceGalore*

Your greatest strength is in recognising who Christ is in you! There are things that the Lord placed on your heart years ago and you've been putting them off for the longest time, you feel inadequate to even attempt the task at hand! The Word of God shows us that He never calls anyone at their level of comfort, He always calls you at His level of ability; that's why He could tell an 80 year old man to go and deliver His people from Egypt! God looks at His ability in you, Christ is your ability, He is your strength, you are well able! 
_Phil 4:13 I can do all things through Christ which strengthens me_
*#GraceGalore*

The work of the Father is Christ is complete and permanent! When one receives it as thus they are catapulted into a greater experience with the Lord, where we do not have to attain anything, all that we do is accept and walk in the fullness of what God has already done for us in Christ! Instead of trying to attain anything, find out what is yours and then be thankful for it! The work is already complete for you Career, relationships, finances, health and safety! And it is Permanent!  
_Joh 19:30 When Jesus therefore had received the vinegar, He said, It is finished: and He bowed His head, and gave up the ghost._
*#GraceGalore*

The Power of Prayer is the fact that we are allowing God to do that which He purposed to do in the Earth, by the Holy Spirit! When God created man He gave him dominion over all the Earth and the works of His hand! Prayer therefore is man opening up the Earth to God's will and purpose! It's not merely making requests, but it's a legal invitation for the Lord to move in the Earth! No time in prayer is ever wasted, the Lord is showing Himself Strong in your life! 
_Mat 6:10 Thy kingdom come. Thy will be done in earth, as it is in heaven._
*#GraceGalore*

There is a desired path for you that the Lord has set, you are not here on Earth to go about by trial and error to succeed, God has a divine destiny for you! Don't lose hope in the dreams God has placed in you!  There is not enough opposition to stop the plan and purposes of God for your life! Our God is greater than all, and He is arising strong within us! The time is now! 
_1Jn 4:4 Ye are of God, little children, and have overcome them: because greater is he that is in you, than he that is in the world_
*#GraceGalore*

Your Faith will yield results, Faith is assurance that God is who He says He is and that He will do what He says He will do. When you do not try to add any human explanation to it, God comes through in mighty ways, Faith gives the word of God expression in the Earth! It is us tapping into the divine Creative Power of the Word! Speak words of Faith in alignment with God's Word and watch miracles manifest in your life! 
_Heb 10:23 Let us hold fast the profession of our faith without wavering; (for he is faithful that promised;_
*#GraceGalore*

There is a fountain of living Waters, available to all that are thirsty. When it comes to the being satisfied in Christ the invitation is for those who are thirsty! That's why it is hard for those who trust in riches and systems of this world to be rooted in Christ, we must have full assurance in Christ! Whenever we come to God it must be in fully given to Him as our only source! 
_Heb 11:6 But without faith it is impossible to please him: for he that cometh to God must believe that he is, and that he is a rewarder of them that diligently seek him_
*#GraceGalore*

What are you looking for out there? it is healing, prosperity, wisdom?The answers are inside you. When you gave your life to Christ all that you ever need was placed inside of you, the solution is closer to you than you may think, when Jesus died took upon Himself all the negative situations that we deserved, now He has come and made His abode in us thus placing everything with would ever require within us! We tap into that life by our words, we draw from the very life of Christ. Speak out today! 
_Col 1:27 ...Christ in you, the hope of glory_
*#GraceGalore*

God's design is for us to be victors in all circumstances, the issues of life were never made to drown us but rather we are called to reign in life, we have been raised together with Christ! When situations are desperate, we have sure victory in Christ for He has overcome the world and its systems! Nothing is powerful enough to bring you down, live life from the point of victory! Greater is He that is in you!  
_Rom 8:37 Nay, in all these things we are more than conquerors through him that loved us._
*#GraceGalore*

You are a priest unto God, you have a role in the Kingdom of your Father! As a Priest you have the responsibility of bringing the will of God into your arena of jurisdiction. Your prayers are what will change the situation around you! It is your voice that the Lord desires to bring about the desired results! As a priest of God you have access to the Throne and Power of God! Engage the Lord in Prayer to bring about change in your family, your city and Nation!
_Rev 5:10 And hast made us unto our God kings and priests: and we shall reign on the earth._
*#GraceGalore*

The knowledge of God is given to His Priests, the Priestly office is one that would be in constant union and fellowship with God even when the whole nation has strayed from the Lord. In the New Testament every believer has been made a priest unto God,  We have an unending fellowship with the Father, therefore access to the knowledge of God! Knowledge is what sets us apart from the world, the Knowledge of who we are in Christ! 
_Hos 4:6 My people are destroyed for lack of knowledge: because thou hast rejected knowledge, I will also reject thee, that thou shalt be no priest to me_
*#GraceGalore*

As a Priest unto God, you have privileges with God and man,  Creation and nature is commanded to favor you to allow you to function in their favor. You live by a different set of rules, you are set apart by the office that you have as a Priest of God! The Levites in the Old Testament were separated unto God as Holy, much more for us in Christ, we are a Nation of Priests Holy unto God! Walk in the Light of your Priesthood! 
_Mat 12:5 Or have ye not read in the law, how that on the sabbath days the priests in the temple profane the sabbath, and are blameless?_
*#GraceGalore*

One of the most important revelations that every believer ought have is the substitutionary work of Christ for them. There is little that can be done out side that,  every believer must be rooted and established in the reality of Christ's death and resurrection! Function in life from that's stand point, the price for all the victory and success that you need is there in Christ substitution for you!  
_2Co 5:21 For he hath made him to be sin for us, who knew no sin; that we might be made the righteousness of God in him._
*#GraceGalore*

Jesus Christ has brought a reality that goes beyond what is seen in the natural. Never judge the work of Christ based on what is seen on the surface. God already perfected all His works when Jesus died and Rose. He brought all things into a new experience! If whatever you are experiencing is different from the reality of the Death of Jesus, don't change you view about what He did,  but rather change your experience to conform to the knowledge of Jesus Christ! It is already done! 
_Joh 17:4 I have glorified thee on the earth: I have finished the work which thou gavest me to do._
*#GraceGalore*

Jesus Christ came to open you up to a perfect relationship and fellowship with God! In the Old Testament the Priests only had fellowship with God when doing there duties. But God has made us permanent priests. Anytime, anywhere we are in fellowship with Him, you are the Temple of the Lord, wherever you are is a place of Fellowship! 
_1Co 3:16 Know ye not that ye are the temple of God, and that the Spirit of God dwelleth in you?_
*#GraceGalore*

The position of High Priest was an office that brought the children of Israel a connection with God! Without that office there was no atonement for sin, there could be no experience with God and his Blessing, the High Priest was the point of contact! In the New Testament Jesus is our High Priest He changed the system and brought us all into the priestly fellowship that His has with the Father! You have unhindered fellowship the veil is torn!
_Heb 4:14 Seeing then that we have a great high priest, that is passed into the heavens, Jesus the Son of God, let us hold fast our profession._
*#GraceGalore*

Jesus as our Lord and Savior is not like a master who asks us to do things He Himself is not will to do,  but rather He went through all the experience that mankind can ever have, He feels all the passions and drives that control men, and that's why He doesn't condemn anyone, only He can save them, Jesus knows exactly where you are and what you are going through! He is here to get you out of any situation today, trust Him.  
_Heb 4:15 For we have not an high priest which cannot be touched with the feeling of our infirmities; but was in all points tempted like as we are, yet without sin_
*#GraceGalore*

We are a nation of priests, everyone of us has a divine fellowship with Almighty God! This fellowship however is not only for ourselves it is for others around us, no priesthood mediates for itself, it is for the people, to benefit and receive from God all that is promised to them. The Lord has called you to be a blessing, to bring to bear the wisdom and Knowledge of God to the Earth! 
_2Chr 30:27 Then the priests the Levites arose and blessed the people: and their voice was heard, and their prayer came up to his holy dwelling place,even unto heaven._
*#GraceGalore*

Before the Children of Israel could be established as a Kingdom,  the Lord established the Priesthood, the Kingly order could only come into existence after the priesthood was in place, for it was the Priests the ushered in the king to his office. For you to walk in the fullness of your Kingly anointing you must have an understanding of your office as a priest first! We are a Royal Priesthood! 
_1Pe 2:9 But ye are a chosen generation, a royal priesthood, an holy nation, a peculiar people;_
*#GraceGalore*

God's plans and purposes are to be done God's way, that's why He sends priests who only carry the will of God and not their own. The priests never followed their own feelings when judging a matter theirs was to pass the Mind of God to the people. As a Priest of God yours is to bring the will of the Father to the Earth you are a conduit through which the blessing flow!  
_2Ki 12:2 Jehoash did what was right in the eyes of the Lord all his days, because he was guided by the teaching of Jehoiada the priest._
*#GraceGalore*

Don't just desire great things, the Lord wants you to attempt great things. Don't keep them in your head,  Heaven does not respond to potential, it responds to actions, what are you believing God for? Put your faith in Action believe what God has placed in you! Ideas will manifest when you put them to action! Do something today push your into the dream God has for you! 
_Jas 2:26 For as the body without the spirit is dead, so faith without works is dead also._
*#GraceGalore*

There is a river deep inside you that flows, God's desire is for it to pour out to people around you and to give life to every person around you! You've never met anyone coincidentally, there is a purpose for every person in your life today, God placed them to receive from what He has placed in you! Let the river flow out and impact the lives in your sphere of contact! You are here to be a blessing!  
_Joh 7:38 He that believeth on me, as the scripture hath said, out of his belly shall flow rivers of living water._
*#GraceGalore*

Self mastery is so important, know yourself and the gifts God has placed in you, don't try to live another person's dream because they seem to be excelling, they were built for it, and you were also built on Purpose and for a Purpose! You'll effortlessly excel in your area of strength once you harness your God given abilities! The seed of Greatness has always been in you! Be and Do You! 
_Phm 1:6 That the communication of thy faith may become effectual by the acknowledging of every good thing which is in you in Christ Jesus._
*#GraceGalore*

Your words are so important they will locate you, what you say will set the course of your life, don't be loose with your words! Speak only that which is consistent with the Word of God! In the New Testament Words are more important than even deeds. Our salvation comes by confessing Jesus as Lord! Our faith calls those things which be not as those they were! Speak Life! 
_Mat 12:37 For by thy words thou shalt be justified, and by thy words thou shalt be condemned._
*#GraceGalore*

Jesus has so much that He desires for us to Live out and have,  and in His death He made all the provisions that you need for you to have and experience the fullness of Life. Yours now is to lay hold of life by faith, recognise that it's already done, and take a hold of it,  declare the finished work of Christ over your life!
_Rom 5:17 For if by one man's offence death reigned by one; much more they which receive abundance of grace and of the gift of righteousness shall reign in life by one, Jesus Christ._
*#GraceGalore*

When it comes to experiencing a touch from God, everyone has a special day that they wait for! But when we look in scripture God doesn't not dwell in time and He says to those in time, "today is the Day of Salvation". Your miracle is ready today, this is the day you've been waiting for!! No more delays, today is the day!
_Luk 19:9 And Jesus said unto him, this day is salvation come to this house, for so much as he also is a son of Abraham._
*#GraceGalore*

The Bible talks about coming to the mindset of the just, there is a way that the just (those made righteous in Christ) think. It is this mindset that puts us above the circumstances of life knowing we are not trying to get victory, but we are functioning from Victory. The battle is already won, the war is over we are now just collecting the spoils of war! After Christ died and Rose He ushered in a season of permanent victory!!
_Col 2:15 And having spoiled principalities and powers, He made a show of them openly, triumphing over them in it. _
*#GraceGalore*

You are a store house of Power,  the very power and presence of the Godhead lives in you, you are filled with His Glory and splendor. God's desire for you is to allow that power to flow out and effect changes in the world around you! You have the ability to effect positive changes in any situation by the Power resident in you! You are a vessel of Power,  and container of the very presence of all mighty God! 
_2Co 4:7 But we have this treasure in earthen vessels, that the excellency of the power may be of God, and not of us._
*#GraceGalore*

What ever that any man shall ever need is granted in Christ! Jesus is answer to all the longing of all mankind, He is the desire of the ages, many have tried to satisfy their lives with so many things to fill voids in their hearts, not knowing that Christ is the Light for every single man on the face of the Earth! God's answer for the sick, the poor,  the weak, the condemned, heart broken, the empty etc.  was, is and shall always be Jesus.
_Joh 1:9 That was the true Light, which lighteth every man that cometh into the world._
*#GraceGalore*

The Joy of any father is the prosperity of his sons,  as Children of God we bring glory to the Father not just saying "we give You glory Lord", it's by living a life that manifests His life in you, you are loaded with great things, manifest and bring joy to the Fathers heart by Prospering and doing great things on the Earth! You are a light, shine for all to see! 
_Psa 35:27 Let them shout for joy, and be glad, that favour my righteous cause: yea, let them say continually, Let the LORD be magnified, which hath pleasure in the prosperity of his servant._
*#GraceGalore*

Heaven knows you are more than a conqueror, in the records of God you are a Victor,  you are reigning in Christ. His expects you to win, all creation also is longing for you to live out the fullness of the blessing of God on your life! You are already a champion, don't let what you maybe experiencing deceive you into thinking you are defeated! You cannot be brought down! 
_2Co 2:14 Now thanks be unto God, which always causeth us to triumph in Christ, and maketh manifest the savour of his knowledge by us in every place_
*#GraceGalore*

When it comes to relating with God and His Word there are no maybe's , or hopefully's, His Word is sure,  all of the Promises of God are Yes and Amen, don't come to God hoping He answers, but rather come boldly Knowing He will do and perform His word in your life, Jesus Loves and cares for you, He never fails, He is showing Himself faithful in your life! Come boldly to Him now.
_Psa 119:89-90 For ever, O LORD, thy word is settled in heaven.Thy faithfulness is unto all generations_
#GraceGalore

For you to function in high authority you must understand Responsibility, God desires us to take responsibility at every level, once you place value on what God has currently given you, He will entrust you with more. Responsibility makes you a candidate for the blessing of the Lord, for He entrusts good stewards with more. Take ownership of your time, your health, your money,  your community, your work.
_Luk 19:17 And he said unto him, Well, thou good servant: because thou hast been faithful in a very little, have thou authority over ten cities_
*#GraceGalore*

The Glory of God is resident in you, when you come to this understanding you'll see how the Lord has called you to be a dispenser of His Glorious Presence,  when people come around your life they are to experience the touch of God! God desires you to be He expression on the Earth! Just as Jesus was the Light of the World He made us the Light,  therefore shine and reveal Christ for all to see. 
_1Pe 2:9 But ye are a chosen generation, a royal priesthood, an holy nation, a peculiar people; that ye should shew forth the praises of him who hath called you out of darkness into his marvellous light:_
*#GraceGalore*

The Power of change in any area of life comes first by knowing that change is possible. What you don't desire to change will stay that way, stagnation happens when comfort zones are embraced. God has called us to do great things, but these will not be achieved if we are not willing to change. The Power of change is available to all who are willing to challenge the status quo. Its time to move to the higher life that is yours in Christ!
_Deu 2:3 "You have circled around this mountain long enough; now turn north"_
*#GraceGalore*

The concept of rule based Christianity is not consistent with what is revealed to us in the New Testament! Agreed there is a life that we are called to live,  but that life is not bound rules. The Life we have in Christ is given to us by Grace, which brought us into freedom, sin is bondage, in Christ we are walking in total freedom! Freedom to love and serve God,  Freedom to prosper and succeed, Freedom from sickness and shame! In Christ we are Free indeed! 
_Joh 8:36 If the Son therefore shall make you free, ye shall be free indeed._
*#GraceGalore*

In this moment look around and see all the beautiful things that the Lord has done for you and all the people he has place in your life, Give thanks to His name and rejoice in the Lord of your salvation,  remember all the great things that He has done for you and be thankful. There is power in being thankful, an attitude of Gratitude will change your altitude. Be Grateful!
_Heb 13:15 By him therefore let us offer the sacrifice of praise to God continually, that is, the fruit of our lips giving thanks to his name._
*#GraceGalore*

Jesus is the Light of the World,  all that mankind has been looking for is vested in Him, no man can find satisfaction outside the person of Jesus Christ, all of us were designed to be filled by His light, this is why Jesus calls us to preach the Gospel to Every Creature, all that Everyone needs is the Gospel, it is what will light the path for all men's lives! Preach Jesus, He is all the world needs! 
_Joh 1:9 That was the true Light, which lighteth every man that cometh into the world._
*#GraceGalore*

The best time to do something that you've always desired to do is now,  it is time to live to the fullness of God's on your life, you've held back for so long, the timing doesn't have to 'feel' rather right you have to be the right person, it more about being than timing. The right person makes the time right. Do you know who you are, from conception God has equipped you with all you need to fulfil those dreams you have. Greater is He that is in you. 
_Ecc 11:4 He that observeth the wind shall not sow; and he that regardeth the clouds shall not reap._
*#GraceGalore*
